description: Gitea/Forgejo configured-host wiring audit: structured fetch locators work, unconfigured hosts are not rewritten, provider status does not overclaim tree/repo_map support.

expect.notes: Gitea/Forgejo uses the same gitea_code/gitea_issues/gitea_releases provider IDs since Forgejo is API-compatible. Unconfigured Gitea-like URLs are NOT rewritten by web_fetch (no code metadata, no browser-to-raw transform). Provider status does not claim tree search or repo_map support for Gitea providers. Tested via 16 targeted unit tests across code_host_fetch, code_metadata, repo_fetch, provider, and repo_mapper.
